sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework
sources.facts: Current framework was revised 12 December 2024 and amended 7 February 2025.
sources.guard: National policy is not a local-plan adoption status, decision notice, exact-site allocation or permission.

sources.title: Plan-making
sources.facts: Updated 27 November 2025 and distinguishes new and legacy plan-making systems.
sources.guard: Guidance does not establish which system an authority is using, whether a plan passed a gateway or whether a policy is adopted.

sources.title: Create or update a local plan using the new system
sources.facts: Updated 6 July 2026; regulations came into force 25 March 2026 and resources are still being released.
sources.guard: Collection and consultation-draft references are not an adopted local plan, completed gateway or final national policy.

sources.title: Creating a plan timetable
sources.facts: Updated 30 June 2026; authorities must publish and keep plan and timetable datasets current.
sources.guard: A timetable date is not completion, adoption, examination outcome or evidence that a milestone occurred.

sources.title: Local plans: examination process, new local plan system
sources.facts: Published 18 June 2026 for the 2026-regulations examination process.
sources.guard: Examination guidance is not submission, soundness, legal compliance, adoption or an examiner recommendation.

sources.title: Creating a design code
sources.facts: A design code is a set of clear, specific physical-development requirements supported by graphics.
sources.guard: Guidance or draft code is not adopted policy, exact-site compliance, design approval or planning permission.

sources.title: Planning obligations
sources.facts: Planning obligations must meet necessity, direct-relation and scale-and-kind tests.
sources.guard: A policy, formula or negotiation record is not an executed obligation, payment, discharge, compliance or infrastructure delivery.

sources.title: Roadmap of resources and support: new local plan-making system
sources.facts: Updated 19 May 2026; resources are released in stages and roadmap will be updated.
sources.guard: Roadmap availability is not authority readiness, gateway passage, completed plan data or adoption.
